mapper.sql: id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, shop_id, platform_name, product_sku_id, product_sku_no, effective_time, expire_time, is_expire, dict_platform, product_name, listing_id, type, warehouse_id, warehouse_name, has_mapping_all, rule_id
mapper.select: select distinct sm.product_sku_id as skuId, sm.shop_id as shopId, sm.dict_platform as platform from sku_mapping sm inner join listing_info li on sm.listing_id = li.id where ${params.sqlMap.default} and sm.is_deleted = false and li.is_deleted = false and sm.is_expire = false

select id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, shop_id, platform_name, product_sku_id, product_sku_no, effective_time, expire_time, is_expire, dict_platform, product_name, listing_id, type, warehouse_id, warehouse_name, has_mapping_all, rule_id from sku_mapping where is_deleted = false and id != #{id} and listing_id = #{listingId} and shop_id = #{shopId} and product_sku_id = #{productSkuId} order by expire_time asc

select id, create_user_id, create_user_name, create_time, update_user_id, update_user_name, update_time, version, is_deleted, shop_id, platform_name, product_sku_id, product_sku_no, effective_time, expire_time, is_expire, dict_platform, product_name, listing_id, type, warehouse_id, warehouse_name, has_mapping_all, rule_id from sku_mapping where listing_id = #{listingId} and product_sku_id != '' order by update_time asc

select sm.id as tableId, sm.dict_platform as dictPlatform, sm.product_sku_id as productSkuId, sm.product_sku_no as productSkuNo, sm.product_name as productName, sm.type as type, sm.warehouse_id as warehouseId, sm.warehouse_name as warehouseName, sm.is_expire as isExpire, li.id as listingId, li.platform_sku_no as platformSkuNo, li.platform_sku_name as platformSkuName, li.platform_spu_no as platformSpuNo, li.platform_spu_name as platformSpuName, li.platform_fn_sku as platformFnSku from sku_mapping sm inner join listing_info li on sm.listing_id = li.id where sm.is_deleted = false and li.is_deleted = false and sm.is_expire = false and sm.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND li.platform_sku_no IN
#{item}
